versos.hebraico: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֕א אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֖ה אֹמֵ֑ר ק֚וּם רִ֣יב אֶת־הֶהָרִ֔ים וְתִשְׁמַ֥עְנָה הַגְּבָע֖וֹת קוֹלֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Listen now to what Yahweh says:  “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
controles.kjv: Hear ye now what the Lord saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
controles.livre: Ouvi agora o que o SENHOR diz: Levanta-te, briga com os montes, e ouçam os morros a tua voz.

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֤וּ הָרִים֙ אֶת־רִ֣יב יְהוָ֔ה וְהָאֵתָנִ֖ים מֹ֣סְדֵי אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽיהוָה֙ עִם־עַמּ֔וֹ וְעִם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִתְוַכָּֽח׃

controles.web: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s controversy, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with his people, and he will contend with Israel.
controles.kjv: Hear ye, O mountains, the Lord’s controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the Lord hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
controles.livre: Ouvi vós, montes, e vós, fortes fundamentos da terra, a briga do SENHOR; porque o SENHOR tem uma briga judicial com seu povo, e disputará judicialmente com Israel.

versos.hebraico: עַמִּ֛י מֶה־עָשִׂ֥יתִי לְךָ֖ וּמָ֣ה הֶלְאֵתִ֑יךָ עֲנֵ֥ה בִּֽי׃

controles.web: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
controles.kjv: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
controles.livre: Ó povo meu, o que eu tenho feito a ti? Em que eu te incomodei? Responde-me.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י הֶעֱלִתִ֨יךָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּמִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִ֖ים פְּדִיתִ֑יךָ וָאֶשְׁלַ֣ח לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּמִרְיָֽם׃

controles.web: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
controles.kjv: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
controles.livre: Pois eu te fiz subir da terra do Egito, e da casa de escravidão eu te livrei; e enviei diante de ti a Moisés, Arão, e Miriã.

versos.hebraico: עַמִּ֗י זְכָר־נָא֙ מַה־יָּעַ֗ץ בָּלָק֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וּמֶה־עָנָ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־בְּע֑וֹר מִן־הַשִּׁטִּים֙ עַד־הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל לְמַ֕עַן דַּ֖עַת צִדְק֥וֹת יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”
controles.kjv: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the Lord.
controles.livre: Ó povo meu, lembra-te agora do Balaque, rei de Moabe, planejou, e do que Balaão, filho de Beor, lhe respondeu, e do que aconteceu desde Sitim até Gilgal, para que conheças as justiças do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: בַּמָּה֙ אֲקַדֵּ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה אִכַּ֖ף לֵאלֹהֵ֣י מָר֑וֹם הַאֲקַדְּמֶ֣נּוּ בְעוֹל֔וֹת בַּעֲגָלִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
controles.kjv: Wherewith shall I come before the Lord, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
controles.livre: Com que me encontrarei com o SENHOR, e adorarei ao alto Deus? Virei diante ele com ofertas de queima, com bezerros de um ano?

versos.hebraico: הֲיִרְצֶ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּאַלְפֵ֣י אֵילִ֔ים בְּרִֽבְב֖וֹת נַֽחֲלֵי־שָׁ֑מֶן הַאֶתֵּ֤ן בְּכוֹרִי֙ פִּשְׁעִ֔י פְּרִ֥י בִטְנִ֖י חַטַּ֥את נַפְשִֽׁי׃

controles.web: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
controles.kjv: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
controles.livre: O SENHOR se agradará de milhares de carneiros, ou de dez mil ribeiros de azeite? Darei meu primogênito por minha transgressão, o fruto de meu ventre pelo pecado de minha alma?

versos.hebraico: הִגִּ֥יד לְךָ֛ אָדָ֖ם מַה־טּ֑וֹב וּמָֽה־יְהוָ֞ה דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ מִמְּךָ֗ כִּ֣י אִם־עֲשׂ֤וֹת מִשְׁפָּט֙ וְאַ֣הֲבַת חֶ֔סֶד וְהַצְנֵ֥עַ לֶ֖כֶת עִם־אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃פ

controles.web: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
controles.kjv: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
controles.livre: Ele já declarou a ti, ó ser humano, o que é bom; e que mais o SENHOR pede de ti, a não ser fazer o que é justo, amar a bondade, e andar humildemente com teu Deus?

versos.hebraico: ק֤וֹל יְהוָה֙ לָעִ֣יר יִקְרָ֔א וְתוּשִׁיָּ֖ה יִרְאֶ֣ה שְׁמֶ֑ךָ שִׁמְע֥וּ מַטֶּ֖ה וּמִ֥י יְעָדָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
controles.kjv: The Lord’s voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
controles.livre: A voz do SENHOR clama à cidade (e sábio é temer o teu nome): Ouvi a vara, e a quem a estabeleceu.

versos.hebraico: ע֗וֹד הַאִשׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע אֹצְר֖וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וְאֵיפַ֥ת רָז֖וֹן זְעוּמָֽה׃

controles.web: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
controles.kjv: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
controles.livre: Não há ainda na casa do perverso riquezas da perversidade, e medida  enganosamente menor, o que é abominável?

versos.hebraico: הַאֶזְכֶּ֖ה בְּמֹ֣אזְנֵי רֶ֑שַׁע וּבְכִ֖יס אַבְנֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃

controles.web: Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?
controles.kjv: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
controles.livre: Posso eu tolerar quem tem balanças falsas e bolsa de pesos enganosos?

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲשִׁירֶ֨יהָ֙ מָלְא֣וּ חָמָ֔ס וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ דִּבְּרוּ־שָׁ֑קֶר וּלְשׁוֹנָ֖ם רְמִיָּ֥ה בְּפִיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.
controles.kjv: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
controles.livre: Pois seus ricos estão cheios de violência, e seus moradores falaram mentiras, e suas línguas são enganosas em suas bocas.

controles.web: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.
controles.kjv: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.
controles.livre: Por isso eu também te enfraquecerei, ferindo-te e assolando-te por teus pecados.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֤ה תֹאכַל֙ וְלֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּ֔ע וְיֶשְׁחֲךָ֖ בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְתַסֵּג֙ וְלֹ֣א תַפְלִ֔יט וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּפַלֵּ֖ט לַחֶ֥רֶב אֶתֵּֽן׃

controles.web: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your humiliation will be in your midst. You will store up, but not save; and that which you save I will give up to the sword.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
controles.livre: Tu comerás, mas não te saciarás; e fome haverá no meio de ti; tu pegarás, mas não levarás contigo ; e o que levares, eu o entregarei à espada.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֥ה תִזְרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א תִקְצ֑וֹר אַתָּ֤ה תִדְרֹֽךְ־זַ֨יִת֙ וְלֹא־תָס֣וּךְ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁתֶּה־יָּֽיִן׃

controles.web: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
controles.livre: Tu semearás, mas não colherás; pisarás azeitonas, mas não te ungirás com óleo; pisarás uvas, mas não beberás vinho.

versos.hebraico: וְיִשְׁתַּמֵּ֞ר חֻקּ֣וֹת עָמְרִ֗י וְכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה בֵית־אַחְאָ֔ב וַתֵּלְכ֖וּ בְּמֹֽעֲצוֹתָ֑ם לְמַעַן֩ תִּתִּ֨י אֹתְךָ֜ לְשַׁמָּ֗ה וְיֹשְׁבֶ֨יהָ֙ לִשְׁרֵקָ֔ה וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖י תִּשָּֽׂאוּ׃פ

controles.web: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and her inhabitants a hissing; And you will bear the reproach of my people.”
controles.kjv: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
controles.livre: Pois são os mandamentos de Onri, e todas as obras da casa de Acabe, que são obedecidos; e vós praticais  seus conselhos. Por isso eu te tornarei desolada, e teus moradores serão motivo de assovio. Assim levareis a humilhação de meu povo.
